entities.summary: Steve Kilbey (b. 1954-09-13, Welwyn Garden City) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Welwyn Garden City and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
